lines.x: Japan's Nikkei index plunged into a bear market, dropping more than 20% from its recent peak amid a global technology stock sell-off.
Asian stock markets tumbled as technology and regional shares slid following the U.S.
Asian equity benchmarks tumbled, with South Korea's Kospi dropping over 8% to trigger a trading halt and Japan's Nikkei sliding into a bear market.

Toyota Motor reported its first quarterly profit gain in six quarters and raised its annual profit forecast on strong demand for hybrid vehicles, prompting its largest single-day share gain since 1987.
